Package foms.models

Class Branch

java.lang.Object
foms.models.Branch
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Branch extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a branch in the system. A branch has a name, location, staff count, staff quota, manager count, manager quota, menu items list, employee list, and payment list. The branch class provides methods to set and get the attributes of a branch.
Since:
2024-04-15
